reason: People already find me on Google Maps and call or WhatsApp me straight from there, and the ones who want to book online go through GetYourGuide or Booking anyway. I don't see why a website changes that enough to be worth €600 now.
objection: I'd pay €600 plus €15 every month and the tourists still book through Viator because they trust it and already have the app. Show me it brings real direct bookings, not just a nice page.
would_change_my_mind: Another taxi or rafting guy from Omiš showing me his WhatsApp bookings went up and his commission bill went down after the site, or paying part of it only after it brings me bookings.
